Title: Need raised
Description: A procurement need was raised.

Title: Sourcing event published
Description: A sourcing event was published to the market.

Title: Submission lodged
Description: A supplier lodged a submission.

Title: Evaluation completed
Description: A submission was evaluated.

Title: Award decided
Description: An award decision was taken.

Title: Contract signed
Description: A contract was executed.

Title: Mandate refused
Description: An agent action was refused because it fell outside the mandate relied on.

Title: Obligation discharged
Description: An obligation reached `met`

Title: Bid placed
Description: A bid was placed or revised in an Auction; the ordered bid.placed stream is the hash-chained auction record.

Title: Sourcing event planned
Description: A sourcing event was created in the planning stage.

Title: Sourcing event closed
Description: The submission window closed and evaluation began.

Title: Sourcing event completed
Description: A sourcing event reached its intended end.

Title: Sourcing event cancelled
Description: A sourcing event was cancelled before completion.

Title: Sourcing event withdrawn
Description: A sourcing event was withdrawn by the procuring party.

Title: Submission created
Description: A submission was created in draft.

Title: Submission admitted
Description: A submission was ruled admissible by an admissibility Decision.

Title: Submission excluded
Description: A submission was ruled inadmissible by an admissibility Decision.

Title: Submission withdrawn
Description: A submission was withdrawn by the supplier.

Title: Obligation created
Description: An obligation was created pending fulfilment.

Title: Obligation breached
Description: An obligation was not fulfilled as required.

Title: Obligation waived
Description: An obligation was waived by the party entitled to enforce it.

Title: Auction scheduled
Description: An auction was created and scheduled.

Title: Auction opened
Description: An auction opened for participation.

Title: Auction started
Description: Bidding began.

Title: Auction closed
Description: An auction closed under its deterministic rules.

Title: Auction cancelled
Description: An auction was cancelled before close.

Title: Bid withdrawn
Description: A bid was withdrawn by the bidder.

Title: Bid won
Description: A bid was determined the winning bid at close.

Title: Bid rejected
Description: A bid was rejected as invalid.

Title: Bid superseded
Description: A standing bid was superseded by a later bid from the same bidder; the payload carries supersededBy.
